# Advanced Script Example

A more complex README format to test LLM-powered parsing.

## Installation

First, make sure you have Python installed.

```bash
pip install requirements.txt
```

## How to Use

To run this amazing script, use the following command:

```shell
chmod +x advanced-script.py
python3 advanced-script.py --input="your text here"
```

You can also run it in verbose mode:

```bash
python3 advanced-script.py --input="sample" --verbose
```

## Examples

Here's a simple example:

```console
$ python3 advanced-script.py --input="Hello World from AI"
Processing text: Hello World from AI
Result: Character count is 20
```

Another example with different input:

```bash
python3 advanced-script.py --input="Test input"
```

Expected result:

```
Processing text: Test input
Result: Character count is 10
```

## Notes

This script handles various input formats and provides detailed output.
